events.title: OpenAI completes $7 billion employee tender offer
events.one_liner: OpenAI completed a $7 billion employee tender offer, valuing the company at $852 billion and allowing staff to sell shares without a public listing, though the company had previously filed confidentially for a potential IPO.
takeaways: Company valued at $852 billion, matching March 2026 fundraising valuation
Employees can liquidate shares without requiring IPO
SEC confidential filing made June 2026 for potential IPO
CEO cited underperformance in prior 12 months, expects strong upcoming results
